::: {.callout-note}
## Source inspected — not an ECPM manual
The public Broadreach republication of this 1994 chapter was read on 20 September 2026. It is catalogued so a 1994 Van der Klift publication is not silently equated with a 1994 ECPM training manual. The chapter does **not** name ECPM, CSIL, BC Rehab, Greater Vancouver Home Support Society, or Vancouver Health Department.
:::

## Annotation

The chapter is about help, friendship, and inclusive education. It argues that excessive help can be disempowering. That is a disability-rights argument from the same year a 1994 ECPM training revision has been hypothesized. It is **not bibliographic evidence** that Van der Klift wrote or revised an ECPM skill-development manual, and it names none of the organizations attached to the 1990 Roeher ECPM citation.

A public-web search in this pass for Van der Klift + ECPM / “Enhanced Consumer Participation Model” / “home support” / “BC Rehab” / “Greater Vancouver Home Support” did not recover a second 1994 title. LinkedIn and Broadreach biographical pages describe later training and mediation work; they do not list an ECPM manual.

`source_type` is `secondary` relative to CSIL institutional history: a 1994 advocacy/education chapter, not a home-support program instrument.

## Open questions

- Whether Van der Klift has any unpublished or unindexed role in ECPM materials.
- Whether a 1994 ECPM training manual exists as a distinct document from this chapter and from the 1990 Roeher-cited manual.
